verdict.rationale: Smithery's core product function is exactly this: a registry/gateway that lets users connect and use third-party MCP servers, with OAuth/credential handling, a CLI (`smithery mcp add`, `smithery tool call`), deep-linking for supported clients, and SDK/tool aggregation across multiple servers. Community security research (tool description injection across hosted servers) actually corroborates that tools from connected servers are executed by agents, reinforcing the capability works, even as it raises trust concerns (reflected in confidence, not verdict). Missing for 10: independent hands-on usability corroboration beyond vendor docs and no live API/schema verification (openapi/llms.txt probes 404).
